_doc: OGRL-20261010-013/014. run39_terrain continued with two changes. (1) Hop-aware enemies use rl_hop_rule 4 (enemycontrol.as default): they ignore a hop and react only once the airborne agent starts an attack. The old rule still answered 51-67% of hops; rule 4 answers 0-4%, and real jump kicks land less often than against stock enemies, so it removes the hop trick without handing out free kicks. Measured on three checkpoints: 1v3 wins vs hop-aware enemies drop from 38/75 (stock enemies) to 4/75, 1v1 from 72/75 to 41/75 -- most of the 1v3 skill was the hop trick. (2) Timeout loss 14 -> 20 (being knocked out costs 12): 22% of run39_terrain fights timed out, 44% against the patient persona; waiting out the clock cost only 2 more than losing.
purpose: OGRL-20261010-014 run39_hop4: run39_terrain + hop-aware rule 4 (attack-only) + timeout loss 20
